answer: Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 13 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in sonnet and cedar lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the gale graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 695 impostors cost 1319 times the honest price and take 26 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
